entries.subject: Re: My Development Insight reports
entries.body:
Hello Kevin,

 

Hope all is well with you.

 

I’ve recently been in conversation with Ilona and I remembered there are some outstanding actions on the My Development reports (see details in my email below).  Only when you have the time, please can you send me an update?

 

Many thanks

Julie

 

From: Julie Hickman <julie.hickman@admin.ox.ac.uk> 
Sent: 23 March 2026 10:34
To: Kevin Lelitte <kevin.lelitte@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: My Development Insight reports

 

Hi Kevin,

 

Hope you’re well and had a nice weekend!

 

I’m just following up on the changes requested by Ilona at the end of last year so that I can update the web guidance and include in the bulletin and upcoming briefing etc, and I have a few questions.

 

1.	New reports in live.  Ilona sent me the following screenprint of the new reports (in red box), but I can’t see these.  Can you confirm when they will be made available for all People Management Administrators in live?

 



 

2.	Move ‘Professional Development’ section.  Is it too late to request that these reports are moved to the ‘Professional Development’ section?  If this is too much to ask then please go ahead as they as are, I just can’t see the logic for the new section.

 

3.	Report logic/ purpose for ‘Gender Analysis’ report. In her handover Ilona didn’t understand the purpose of this report.  Please can you confirm what data the report is designed to return so that I can describe it correctly?  She guessed that this report will only include employees that have had CDRs and PDRs allocated to them, or those who have recorded Professional days, or both.  The ‘Professional Development’ report includes gender, so I’m just trying to understand when departments would run either report.  

 

4.	Add Gender to Review Status.  Ilona requested that a Gender column was added to the Review Status report, can you confirm what the status is on that one too.

 

Many thanks for your help!

Julie
entries.ai_note: Julie asks Kevin about Development Insight reports and mentions recent conversation with Ilona.
